svg.title: Git Shadowtree: one shared worktree, two repositories
svg.desc: A single working directory is the shared worktree of two repositories. The main repository tracks the project files and pushes them to the customer remote. The shadow repository tracks the agent files and pushes them to a separate remote, so they never reach the customer.

g.text: one folder on disk — worktree for both repos

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the main repository track and how is it pushed?')
sendPrompt('What is the shadow repository and why is it a bare overlay?')
sendPrompt('Why does the customer remote never receive the shadow files?')
sendPrompt('What is the separate shadow remote used for?')
